identity.gate_semantics: identical to v4/v5/v9; no threshold moved

selection_formula.eligibility: exposure >= 10 vehicles in every variant and window, AND the edge survives its own closure under survives_own_closure_v2
selection_formula.eligibility_rationale: v9's exposure floor is unchanged and keeps the ranking signal from selecting its own degenerate cases; the survivability condition is added because v9 failed ranking_case_fraction with three of five cases producing zero eligible schedules — selection had proved the edges carried demand but never asked whether closing them strands anyone
selection_formula.expected_discriminating: the top two by that ranking
selection_formula.inputs: canonical archived demand routes, tracked topology and the derived SUMO connection graph only
selection_formula.not_a_prediction: a selection signal only; it does not guarantee a SUMO objective spread
selection_formula.ranking: mean relative temporal range, then median support, then edge id
selection_formula.raw_evidence: each selected case records schedule_ids, the q10/q50/q90 vehicle exposure for every one of those windows in the same order, and its full survivability report
selection_formula.recomputation: per variant let low=min(window_exposure) and high=max(window_exposure); temporal_variation = mean over q50,q10,q90 of (high-low)/high, rounded to 6dp; median_support = median over variants of median(window_exposure), rounded to 3dp; min_support = min over variants of low; eligibility requires low>=10 everywhere AND survives_own_closure

survivability_rule.disqualifies: any vehicle crossing the edge whose destination becomes unreachable once the edge is removed, measured from the edge immediately before the closure on that vehicle's own route; or any successor left with the closed edge as its only incoming connection
survivability_rule.does_not_disqualify: denied departures (routes starting on the edge). Every street with departures has some, so gating on them would refuse to close any real street — the mistake C1 fixed on 2026-08-06. They are recorded per candidate instead.
survivability_rule.worst_variant: an edge that severs under ANY of q50/q10/q90 is refused

topology_rules.excludes: every prior campaign edge, its reverse and shared-junction neighbours
